notes.title: Hollow Floor - Release Date
notes.notes:
I hope that you are all alright. About the release date, the game is almost done and it is in its final testing phase so finally, a release date is available which is August 27th ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

If you haven't heard about Hollow Floor, It is a small metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. I have been working on it for [url=https://twitter.com/hashtag/HollowFloor]multiple years[/url]. Now, try the game and leave comments and feedback :) Also if you enjoyed it please [url= https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815150/Hollow_Floor/ ]wishlist it on Steam[/url]. I am looking forward to everyone testing the final game when it comes out.

notes.title: Steam Demo is out
notes.notes:
I hope that you are all alright. For Steam Next Fest, I am releasing the Hollow Floor Demo here on steam beside Newgrounds so more people can try the game and play it before announcing the release date which hopefully will be soon :) Unfortunately, I couldn't be a part of the actual festival as I created the game page after the time to subscribe to be part of the event. It would be great if you can notify people and use some word of mouth :) The steam demo have controller support :)

notes.title: Hollow Floor - Demo is out on Newgrounds
notes.notes:
I hope that you are all alright. If you are following me on [url=https://twitter.com/Amidos2006]Twitter[/url], you would know that I have been working for [url=https://twitter.com/hashtag/HollowFloor]multiple years[/url] on a small metroidvania game called Hollow Floor. The game is inspired by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/70300/VVVVVV/]VVVVVV[/url] and [url=https://w.itch.io/redder]REDDER[/url].

I managed to finish a demo for Hollow Floor and release it exclusively on [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/]Newgrounds[/url] for everyone to enjoy with a speedrun table and 6 achievements :) I am working now on the steam demo but unfortunately it won't have the achievements as they will be released with the full game later :)

Go try it and leave comments and feedback :) Also if you enjoyed it please wishlist it on Steam.
